cli.description: Send text to LSLED name badges via Bluetooth LE or USB
cmd.preview: preview in the terminal without sending
cmd.send: show the preview and send to the badge
cmd.web: start the web interface with live preview
opt.name: font name, default: file name without .flf
opt.autoscroll: scroll left if the text does not fit on the display
opt.address: badge address (lsled scan), default $LSLED_ADDR; for USB the first badge plugged in
msg.web_url: Web interface: {url}  (sending works in Chrome or Edge only, Ctrl+C quits)
msg.autoscroll: Text too wide for the display, scrolling left.
err.no_address: Address missing: set --address or LSLED_ADDR (lsled scan shows it)
err.font_too_tall: Font is {height} rows tall, the display has {max}
err.too_wide: Text is {width} pixels wide, {usable} fit on the display in this mode. Choose a smaller font, mode left or right, --autoscroll or --pages.
err.not_flf: {path} is not a figlet font file
web.scrolling: {width} pixels wide, the badge scrolls the strip
web.autoscrolled: {width} pixels wide, too wide for the display: scrolling left
web.too_wide: Text is {width} pixels wide, {usable} fit on the display in this mode. Choose a smaller font, a scrolling mode or another option under “If too wide”.
web.no_bluetooth: This browser does not support Web Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Edge.
err.mode_unsupported: Badge type '{driver}' does not support mode '{mode}'. Available: {modes}
err.device_not_found: Badge {address} not found. Is it switched on, in Bluetooth mode and in range? lsled scan lists the badges nearby.
opt.pages: split text that does not fit on the display into pages shown one after another
err.word_too_wide: The word “{word}” is {width} pixels wide, {usable} fit on the display. Choose a smaller font or a scrolling mode.
err.too_many_pages: The text needs {count} pages, this badge type shows at most {max}. Shorten the text or choose a smaller font.
msg.paged: Text too wide for the display, shown as {count} pages.
web.paged: {count} pages, each up to {usable} pixels wide
err.no_usb_badge: No USB badge found. Is it plugged in?
err.usb_not_found: USB badge {address} not found. Is it still plugged in? lsled scan lists the badges plugged in.
